data.summary: The Global Muster Research Institute confirms your place in its summer research programme. The signed participation form must be returned by 07/08/2026, which is most likely 7 August 2026.
data.explanation: You have been offered a place in the summer research programme. To keep it, sign the participation form and send it back to the International Study Office. The letter says forms received after the date cannot be considered. The date is printed as 07/08/2026. The letter is in English and from an institute in Germany, so this is most likely 7 August 2026, not 8 July. Check with the office (studies@gmri.example) if you are unsure. No form was attached to the text I received, so make sure you have it.
